infoLinks.urlText: Dulwich Hill bus diversions for Dulwich Hill Festival
infoLinks.content:
From 3am until 9pm on Sunday 21 September, route 418 and 426 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for the Dulwich Hill Festival event.  

Services will divert around a section of Marrickville Road via Wardell Road, Frazer Street and New Canterbury Road. 
 
Route 426 services travelling towards Dulwich Hill will start end trips at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (Stop ID 220354). Route 426 services travelling away from Dulwich Hill will start trips at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (220350).  
 
Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  
 
Missed and alternative stops: 
  • Dulwich Hill Shops, Marrickville Rd (Stop ID 220317) – Alternative stop at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (220350) 
  • Marrickville Rd at Fairfowl St (Stop ID 220339) – Alternative stop at Dulwich Hill Shops, New Canterbury Rd (220350)

  • Daily from 7am to 6pm, buses replace some trains between Richmond and Clarendon or Blacktown.

infoLinks.content:

Services travelling towards Earlwood/Hurstville will divert via Fricourt Avenue and Wardell Road to return to route on Homer Street.  
 
Services travelling away from Hurstville/Earlwood will divert via William Street to return to route on Cameron Avenue.  
 
Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.

urlText: South West Sydney bus changes from Sunday 14 September
content:
From Sunday 14 September, we’ll be making changes to some bus services across Western and South West Sydney.
 
The changes improve reliability and connectivity, with new timetables introduced on routes 901, 902, 902X, 903, 904, 905, 906, 907, 908, 909, 911, 913, 914, 916, 925, M90, M91, S1, S3 and S5.
 
Adjustments will also be made to some school services. See our news story for more details.
 
Please use the Trip Planner to see if these changes affect your travel.
subtitle: South West Sydney bus changes from Sunday 14 September

infoLinks.urlText: Route 850 is changing from 31 August
infoLinks.content:
• From Sunday 31 August, Route 850 services will no longer operate via Gregory Hills Drive to Gregory Hills Town Centre, instead it will operate via Camden Valley Way providing customers with a more efficient trip.
  • Alternative bus routes operating via Gregory Hills Drive and Town Centre include:
    • For travel to Minto, passengers can travel to Campbelltown Station via Route 840 and change to the T8 South and Airport Line.
    • For travel between Oran Park and Gregory Hills, passengers can use bus route 840.
    • For travel to Narellan passengers can use bus route 841. Timetable changes will also affect this route.
  • Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. Buses replace some trains
infoLinks.content:
Monday 22 September  
  • From 10pm to 11pm, at Hawkesbury River and Cowan, all trains leave from platform 2.
  • From 11pm to 3.30am, trains towards Hornsby will not stop at Cowan.
  • At Hawkesbury River, all trains leave from platform 2.
  • Buses run from Hawkesbury River to Cowan, and from Cowan to Berowra, in that direction only.
  • Change at Hawkesbury River for a bus to Cowan. From Cowan, catch a bus to Berowra then change for a train to continue your journey.
  • Trains towards Gosford continue to stop at Cowan.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for a special event
infoLinks.content:
From 1:30am to 12:00pm on Sunday 14 September, route 525 and route 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the NSW Half Marathon Championship.
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue, Olympic Boulevard and Showground Road. Services will miss some stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue. Catch these services from the alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations.
 
Closed stops
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue before Edwin Flack Avenue (212788)
    • Alternative stop: Edwin Flack Avenue opposite Accor Stadium (212735)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue after Edwin Flack Avenue (212787)
    • Alternative stop: Accor Stadium, Edwin Flack Avenue (212736)

infoLinks.urlText: Mount Kembla bus service changes
infoLinks.content:
Some bus services on route 36, S098 and S101 bus services will terminate earlier and not run after Cordeaux Rd due to roadworks. 

Buses will now terminate at Araluen Avenue, Mt Kembla Village and will not travel beyond this point. 
 
From Thursday 12 June, a shuttle bus will run for school students between Mt Kembla and Cordeaux Rd near Araluen Ave to connect them to their regular school services. The shuttle will depart from Harry Graham Dr at 7.55am each weekday connecting with the S098, and will connect with the S098 and S101 at 3.33pm each afternoon. This shuttle bus is an initiative between bus operator Premier and Wollongong City Council.

Plan ahead and allow extra travel time.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield
infoLinks.content:
Monday 15 and Tuesday 16 September  
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Macarthur, Glenfield and the City via Granville.
  • Buses also replace T8 trains between Glenfield and Sydenham.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
9T2 Leppington, Edmondson Park, Glenfield and return
